const [openModalWin, setOpenItemWin] = useState(false) const rewardItems = [ { id: 1, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$0.1", reward: "0.1" }, { id: 2, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$0.15", reward: "0.15" }, { id: 3, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$0.2", reward: "0.2" }, { id: 4, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$0.5", reward: "0.5" }, { id: 5, img: rw3, reward: "x1_duck" }, { id: 6, img: rw3, reward: "x2_duck" }, { id: 7, img: rw3, reward: "x5_duck" }, { id: 8, img: rw2, reward: "Lucky_Clover" }, { id: 9, img: rw2, reward: "Lucky_Clover" }, ]; const handleMine = async (index: number) => { setIsClick(true) if (isClick) return try { const res = await requestService.post('/checkin/mine') if (res && res.data && user) { onSetUser({ ...user, realBalance: user?.realBalance - 0.2 }) const resultReward = res.data.data; const targetIndex = rewardItems.findIndex((item) => item.reward === resultReward); if (targetIndex === -1) throw new Error("Reward not found"); setActiveIndex(index) setItemWinner(rewardItems[targetIndex]) handleCallbackUser() setTimeout(() => { setOpenItemWin(true) }, 1000); } } catch (error) { console.log(error); } setIsClick(false) } console.log('===================================='); console.log(itemWinner); console.log('===================================='); return (

- Mỗi ngày, người chơi sẽ nhận được một lượt mở rương miễn phí nếu đang sở hữu vé chơi (Ticket vịt).
